map_structure_apply_fn: apply a function to all leaves of a nested tree structure using tree.map_structure
parallel_map_parallel_apply: apply a function in parallel across all leaves of nested tree structures with configurable workers
parallel_map_with_progress: apply a function in parallel across nested trees with a progress bar and 32 workers
parallel_map_multiple_trees: apply a function in parallel across multiple nested tree arguments simultaneously
parallel_map_exception_handling: apply a function in parallel across nested trees with automatic exception propagation to the main thread
